name: known differences from a real machine

intended.reason: the clocks differ by the seconds between the two runs
the container runs different processes with different PIDs than the simulated machine
real bash help lists every builtin; the simulator lists the commands it simulates
the environment of a docker exec differs from a login's, and bash orders it by hash
the simulated / holds only the world's directories, not a whole Ubuntu system
the simulated /usr/bin holds only the programs the simulator implements
simulated programs are tiny placeholder files
the kernel build string of the host differs from the simulated one
docker manages /etc/hostname itself; the test worlds do not define it
